alice.su - Support: Escalation from customer in EU private deployment — calls to tool 'Translate' suddenly erroring with 400. They say this started after we applied a rename/alias last week. assigning @ben.jiang

carmen - Customer: reproduced here: POST /v1/call-tool with tool_name=translate_v2 returns schema validation error. worked previously.

alice.su - Support: Can you paste the request and exact error? Also which deployment (eu-west-2 private) and API key scope?

carmen - Customer: key scope is org:prod. repro: ```json
{
  "tool": "translate_v2",
  "args": {"text":"hello","target":"es"}
}
``` response: ```json
{
  "error": "ToolInvocationError",
  "message": "invalid args: unexpected field 'target' for tool 'image_translate' (expected 'lang')",
  "code": 400
}
```

alice.su - Support: Wait — response is saying image_translate. But request used translate_v2. that smells like tool lookup picked wrong tool. tagging @ben.jiang and @jack-oncall

ben.jiang - Eng: digging. private registry backfill ran on Tue. There was a legacy handle 'Translate' (capital T) used by a few old services plus a new canonical name 'translate' and an alias 'translate_v2' created in the hosted registry. We have casefolding + alias sync logic that can differ between hosted and private registries.

ben.jiang - Eng: quick check: registry lookup logs for that org in eu-west-2 show tool_selector matched on handle lowercased and then resolved by alias fallback which returned tool_id of "img-translate-uuid" instead of text-translate-uuid. suspect alias collision + older handle precedence.

jack-oncall: I see deploy-bot posted a backfill job finish: `deploy-bot: private-registry-backfill eu-west-2 completed 2026-01-12T03:45Z`. Might have applied legacy handle promotion.

alice.su - Support: Carmen — can you try calling with tool_name set to the explicit tool UUID (if you can) or try exact casing 'Translate'?

carmen - Customer: tried exact 'Translate' and it returns the same error (image_translate schema). UUID not available in their config UI. They said SDK does casefolding on names by default so clients probably send lowercase.

ben.jiang - Eng: Possible root causes: 1) alias "translate_v2" existed in hosted registry pointing to text-translate-uuid; when we ran backfill, a legacy handle 'translate' in private registry was owned by image team and took precedence. 2) alias sync job didn't map alias -> canonical in that org because it used a diff algorithm that ignored case-only renames. planning a repro locally.

ben.jiang - Eng: Repro steps I'm about to run: (1) create private registry entry for handle 'Translate' -> image-translate-uuid (2) create alias 'translate_v2' -> text-translate-uuid in hosted catalog (3) run backfill sync job and observe resolution. I'll post logs.

alice.su - Support: In the short term: can we add a temporary alias on the private registry to point 'translate_v2' -> text-translate-uuid for that org? Or roll back the backfill? Customer is blocked.

ben.jiang - Eng: I can push a targeted alias patch for org-id: org-9423 in eu-west-2. will need approval for manual registry edit. cc @jack-oncall for rollback window.

jack-oncall: approve. set maintenance window 10m. I'll monitor.

ben.jiang - Eng: patch applied: created alias translate_v2 -> text-translate-uuid scoped to org-9423 in eu-west-2. dev logs: `alias_resolve:org=org-9423 alias=translate_v2 -> text-translate-uuid (source=manual-patch)`.

carmen - Customer: confirmed — calls now route to correct tool and error changed to expected missing param for text translate (we got 422 now). thanks! :tada:

alice.su - Support: Great. Next steps: ben to add a durable fix so alias sync handles case-only renames and private registry collisions, and add a detection alert for alias->wrong-tool resolution. ben will create an infra ticket.

ben.jiang - Eng: filing ticket INFRA-2026 with repro, root cause notes, and proposed fixes (1) make alias sync prefer explicit alias mappings over legacy-handle precedence, (2) add casefolded rename reconciliation, (3) add a daily consistency check that samples orgs and verifies alias -> uuid mapping matches hosted catalog.

alice.su - Support: also adding runbook note for support: how to triage (check lookup logs, try explicit casing and UUID, apply manual alias patch).

jack-oncall: marking incident as resolved for customer. will track INFRA-2026.

deploy-bot: incident-tag=alias-shadowed-legacy-handle status=resolved by=ben.jiang
